field.label: Description
field.help: Letters, numbers, spaces and underscores only.

field.label: Protocol
field.help: Sprint 2 generates Modbus rules. Other protocols are reserved for later sprints.

field.label: Source IP
field.help: Source address or CIDR, or any.

field.label: Destination IP
field.help: Destination address or CIDR, or any.

field.label: Destination port
field.help: Destination port for the selected protocol.

field.label: Action
field.help: Pass creates Suricata pass rules, block creates drop rules.

field.label: Access
field.help: Read and write map to predefined Modbus function code sets when function codes are empty.

field.label: Function codes
field.help: Use 1,2,3 or leave empty to use the access preset.

field.label: Modbus unit ID
field.help: Use a single unit id or a range such as 1-10.

field.label: DNP3 object group
field.help: Use comma separated DNP3 object group numbers.

field.label: Start time
field.help: Optional HH:MM start of the active window.

field.label: End time
field.help: Optional HH:MM end of the active window.

field.label: Log only
field.help: Generate alert rules regardless of the selected action.
